title: 街路自動販売機
description: 独立した商品棚と缶、透明窓、操作部、受取口を備えた汎用自動販売機。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 繰り返し部品は材質と構成単位ごとに統合済み。
descriptionEn: Generic stocked vending cabinet with transparent display, separate cans and shelves, keypad, payment hardware, delivery pocket and rear cooling louvers. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Repeated static details are grouped by material and assembly; the procedural source retains the editable construction.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
